title: Abatacept for therapy of IgG4-related disease
official: Deciphering B and T cell Co-stimulation for the Targeted Treatment of IgG4-Related Disease
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the efficacy of abatacept in reducing the risk of disease recurrence at 48 weeks
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female subjects of legal age and able to provide informed consent
2. Patients with active IgG4-related disease naive to therapy or relapsing with an IgG4- RD RI > 2
3. Achievement of the 2019 ACR/EULAR Classification Criteria of IgG4-related disease.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Malignancy within 5 years
2. Serum creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL at the time of randomisation.
3. Positive pregnancy test at screening or during the study, or breast feeding
4. Subjects who do not agree to use methods of contraception.
5. Chronic or history of recurrent infections over 6 months prior to screening
6. Evidence of severe active liver disease unrelated to IgG4RD
7. Concomitant uncontrolled disease that would interfere with the study procedures
8. Positive HIV, HBV, HCV serology
9. Positive quantiferon test
10. Inability to be tapered of glucocorticoid therapy by 8 weeks post randomisation
11. Prior use of B cell depleting agents within 6 months of enrolment
12. Leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, or anemia
